title: Write the rule semantics once

---

A rule's delay kind is inferred from `Consume == null` and `Axonal` separately in `CompiledNetwork`, `NetworkSimulation`, `VerilogExporter`, `UppaalExporter` and `HardwareProfile`; applicability is written in `SpikeCondition`, `Rule`, `CompiledNetwork`, the Metal kernel, and as strings in two exporters; and spikes produced (`Fire ? (IsStandard ? Produce : 1) : 0`) is computed in three places though `Produce` already defaults to 1.
We want `DelayKind` as an enum on `Rule`, one `Rule.Applies`, one `Rule.Spikes` (what it sends), and `SpikeCondition` split by concern.

Its responsibilities are:
* `DelayKind` (none, closing, holding, axonal) as a property of `Rule`, used by every caller in place of the inference
* `Rule.Applies` and the lasso lookup as the one applicability rule, with `CompiledNetwork.RuleMatches` and `RuleApplies` calling it or reading its compiled table
* The produce branch removed where `Produce` already gives the answer
* `SpikeCondition.cs` (346 lines) split into the lasso table, the Glushkov automaton, and the regex parser
* `Rule.Matches`, used only by tests, removed or made the one applicability check

The JSON form of rules should not change, because saved networks and parts must load as before.

Where: `SNP_Evolution/Networks/Rule.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Networks/SpikeCondition.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Simulation/CompiledNetwork.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Simulation/NetworkSimulation.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Export/VerilogExporter.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Export/UppaalExporter.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Evolution/HardwareProfile.cs`, `SNP_Evolution/Networks/NetworkNotation.cs`.

Done when:
- [ ] `grep -rn "Consume == null" SNP_Evolution/` finds only `Rule`
- [ ] No file but `SpikeCondition`'s and `Rule.cs` decides whether a rule applies, apart from generated code
- [ ] Each new file is under 300 lines with one job
- [ ] Golden runs unchanged; `dotnet test` green

Read first: README "Rule forms", RESEARCH.md "Hardware profile and exporters" (Delays)
